title: Ordered Tree Range Sum
description: Given a binary search tree and two bounds L and R, calculate the sum of all node values whose values lie in the inclusive range [L, R].
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; all BST node values are distinct; L <= R; the root is never missing.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n values in level-order representation, where -1 represents a missing node. Third line: L and R.
outputFormat: Print the sum of all node values in the inclusive range [L, R].
hints: Use the BST ordering to avoid exploring subtrees that cannot contain values in the range.

examples.explanation: The values 6, 8, 10 and 12 lie in the requested range.
Only the node with value 2 lies in the requested range.
